$comment: Gzipped bytes per dist-cdn manifest entry, including every chunk it imports (static and dynamic), each counted once. About 12% over the sizes at 1.0.0; checked by test/size-budget.test.mjs. Print today's sizes with: node scripts/bundle-sizes.mjs. Dark mode (color-scheme-switch) raised site-page.js, site-header.js and tokens.css to about 12% over their sizes with it. bento-box.js (with its four sections) is about 12% over its first size, 19,741 B. Analytics: site-page.js counts its lazy site-analytics (loaded only with matomo-id) and grew by 2,620 B to 36,829 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 39,800; uvalib-analytics.js (the same code as site-analytics.js) is about 12% over its first size, 10,225 B. Breadcrumbs: uvalib-breadcrumbs.js is about 12% over its first size, 10,576 B; site-page.js grew 171 B for the breadcrumbs slot (37,336 B, within its budget). Alerts UI: site-page.js counts its lazy site-alerts (loaded only while alerts are on) and grew by 8,600 B to 46,379 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 49,400; site-alerts.js (with its analytics reporting) is about 12% over its first size, 17,967 B; tokens.css grew 201 B to 1,384 B for the --uva-color-alert-* role tokens, budget 1,550.
